FoodNomsCTL Bridge v2026.09.07.2327 — generated by foodnomsctl-bridge 1.0 from intents.yaml. Do not edit actions by hand; regenerate, or the next build silently reverts the edit.
The write path for foodnomsctl. Takes a JSON request as input, dispatches on its `command` key, and calls the matching FoodNoms App Intent. Writing to the FoodNoms store directly is not an option — it is CloudKit-mirrored, so a row inserted behind the app never syncs.
Commands: log, log-meal, create-food, delete, entries, goal
